scope: Single synthetic cohort only. No GUI/model/device/ETW or production import. Coarse >=500ms CPU and <=250ms idle controls; not 3%/1% or short-call precision qualification.
failures: Retain all windows and lock; abort on first failure; never retry to replace failure.
limits: time.thread_time and GetThreadTimes share OS accounting, not independent hardware validation.
Cycles are recorded only as monotone execution evidence; no frequency or GIL attribution.
100 boundary read widths do not estimate actual-load perturbation.
